name: Han Chol Man

attribution.legal_posture: Kumgang Bank representative and payment facilitator sanctioned by the United States and Republic of Korea; named by an issuing government or multilateral sanctions-monitoring source, with charging status separate. Administrative sanctions designation; the record has no criminal charge or conviction.

caveats: Employment aliases may be stolen, borrowed, or synthetic identities; alias ownership and worker identity remain source-unresolved.

The 2024 OFAC action and Federal Register render the Korean name as 한절만, while the ROK release renders it 한철만. Preserve the discrepancy as source-specific spelling for one record; Vladivostok belongs to the separately listed Jong Song Ho and stays outside Han's profile.

sources.support: Treasury identifies Han Chol Man as a Shenyang, China-based representative of Kumgang Bank, reports that he coordinated or facilitated more than $1 million in payments between China and the DPRK from 2019 to 2023 and more than $600,000 in 2023 payment orders with an unnamed MID-subordinate bank, and records his E.O. 13722 designation. These are administrative-source assessments, not adjudicated findings; no account, instruction, counterparty, or transaction selector is retained

identity_boundary: Han Chol Man, listed by OFAC as HAN, Chol Man with the alternate romanization HAN, Ch'o'l-man, is the person identified by the ROK as 한철만 and described by Treasury as a Kumgang Bank representative. The 2024 OFAC action renders the Korean name as 한절만 while the ROK source renders it 한철만; preserve that source discrepancy. Separate personhood, criminal guilt, present location, and same-named public-account ownership remain unresolved.
